title: From Measurement to Mitigation: Exploring the Transferability of Debiasing Approaches to Gender Bias in Maltese Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: The study measures gender bias using a combination of metrics: CrowS-Pairs to evaluate explicit stereotyping, the Sentence Encoder Association Test (SEAT) for implicit biases, a Sentence Template-Based Analysis that probes Masked Language Models using specific templates with male and female names, and t-SNE visualizations to map the latent semantic space and clustering of adjectives around gendered occupational terms.
